entries.source: but nobody knew why they suddenly became evil
entries.target: 但是没有人知道为什么他们突然变得邪恶了

entries.source: You have %d class talent point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 职业技能点数，按下p来使用。

entries.source: The severed front half of a minotaur snout, ring and all.
entries.target: 从米诺陶口鼻部割下来的前半截，连鼻环一起。
暴击时 精神溅射伤害

entries.source: Bluish and wickedly sharp. It makes your arm hair stand on end.
entries.target: 这只爪子泛着蓝色光泽并且锋利的吓人，它使你汗毛竖立。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和意志。

entries.source: Unlike the rest of the black mamba, the severed head isn't moving.
entries.target: 不像这条蛇的其他部分，这颗头一动不动。

entries.source: A strange blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团奇怪胶状物体。
确认忽略所有来自%s的消息

entries.source:
As you stand on the stairs you can feel this is a "do or die" one way trip. If you enter there will be no coming back.
Enter?
entries.target:
当你站在楼梯上时，你能感觉到这是一次不能回头的战斗，非生既死，一旦进去就不能回来。
现在进去么？
暴击时 暗影溅射伤害

entries.source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
entries.target: 我已经熟练掌握了，但我想成为一名专家。(增加技能树系数0.2) - 750 金币。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+3 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.source:
The pedestal seems to react to something in your bag. After some tests you notice it is the %s.
Do you wish to use the orb on the pedestal?
entries.target:
这个基座似乎对你包里的东西有反应。经过测试后，你发现是包里的%s.
你想在这个基座上使用这个水晶球吗？

entries.source: There is no portal to activate here.
entries.target: 这里没有可用的传送门。

entries.source: You fix the crystal on the %s and create the %s.
entries.target: 你将水晶安装在%s，制造了%s。
